title: Infernux v0.4.3-v5 · Hotfix 5: Game Input and Preview Control
codename: Hotfix 5: Game Input and Preview Control
summary: This hotfix repairs game UI input in the editor and restores control of the Game preview resolution. The base engine version remains 0.4.3; wheels use build 5, with the matching Hub bundle at 0.4.3-6.

items.title: Process game pointer transitions independently of editor panel redraws, so short clicks reach game UI without rebuilding every editor panel for each click.
items.text: Process game pointer transitions independently of editor panel redraws, so short clicks reach game UI without rebuilding every editor panel for each click.

items.title: Request a GUI frame for each physical input batch even while continuous MCP semantic capture holds the frame scheduler active. Input edges no longer disappear before the next panel update.
items.text: Request a GUI frame for each physical input batch even while continuous MCP semantic capture holds the frame scheduler active. Input edges no longer disappear before the next panel update.

items.title: Keep raw editor input separate from game-owned mouse buttons, keys, wheel and text. Resolve actual window occlusion, popups and text editing before assigning new game input; preserve releases for presses already owned by the game.
items.text: Keep raw editor input separate from game-owned mouse buttons, keys, wheel and text. Resolve actual window occlusion, popups and text editing before assigning new game input; preserve releases for presses already owned by the game.

items.title: Keep retained UI geometry when an ordinary numeric field is assigned an equal integer or float value, avoiding needless invalidation in animated controls.
items.text: Keep retained UI geometry when an ordinary numeric field is assigned an equal integer or float value, avoiding needless invalidation in animated controls.

items.title: Expose read-only UI input routing and existing frame timing details through the editor automation host for diagnosis without generating events or submitting UI work.
items.text: Expose read-only UI input routing and existing frame timing details through the editor automation host for diagnosis without generating events or submitting UI work.

items.title: Restore the Game resolution selector when a project has a fixed render output. Users choose fixed or custom preview resolutions independently of project output and camera settings.
items.text: Restore the Game resolution selector when a project has a fixed render output. Users choose fixed or custom preview resolutions independently of project output and camera settings.

items.title: Add Auto resolution, which follows the Game panel's available area and framebuffer scale. Fixed resolution previews retain their selected dimensions across Play and Stop.
items.text: Add Auto resolution, which follows the Game panel's available area and framebuffer scale. Fixed resolution previews retain their selected dimensions across Play and Stop.

items.title: Map pointer coordinates independently on both axes, keeping game UI hit testing aligned with the preview at fractional scales and different aspect ratios.
items.text: Map pointer coordinates independently on both axes, keeping game UI hit testing aligned with the preview at fractional scales and different aspect ratios.

items.title: Preserve font asset handles when copying serialized UI styling, retaining their native asset identity and Player dependency tracking.
items.text: Preserve font asset handles when copying serialized UI styling, retaining their native asset identity and Player dependency tracking.

items.title: Keep the renderer running when a UI material references a missing shader. Skip only the affected draw, report it once until the dependency changes, and resume after a successful import.
items.text: Keep the renderer running when a UI material references a missing shader. Skip only the affected draw, report it once until the dependency changes, and resume after a successful import.

items.title: Drain pending asset imports while their plugin modules are still loaded, before unloading plugins and releasing native resources during shutdown.
items.text: Drain pending asset imports while their plugin modules are still loaded, before unloading plugins and releasing native resources during shutdown.

items.title: Retire native Player scenes before releasing the asset catalog, so component disable and destroy callbacks can still resolve their font and other asset references during shutdown.
items.text: Retire native Player scenes before releasing the asset catalog, so component disable and destroy callbacks can still resolve their font and other asset references during shutdown.

items.title: Preserve signal handlers owned by embedded native hosts, avoiding an Android exit exception that interrupted normal engine cleanup.
items.text: Preserve signal handlers owned by embedded native hosts, avoiding an Android exit exception that interrupted normal engine cleanup.

items.title: Ignore access-time and attribute-only script notifications when the recorded modification time and size are unchanged, preventing needless plugin restarts during Windows Player builds.
items.text: Ignore access-time and attribute-only script notifications when the recorded modification time and size are unchanged, preventing needless plugin restarts during Windows Player builds.

items.title: Reload changed plugin helpers even when equal-size edits share an integer-second timestamp, while retaining unchanged import caches.
items.text: Reload changed plugin helpers even when equal-size edits share an integer-second timestamp, while retaining unchanged import caches.

items.title: Report unmatched GUI tree pops before changing layout or ID state, preventing malformed custom panels from leaving errors in subsequent frames.
items.text: Report unmatched GUI tree pops before changing layout or ID state, preventing malformed custom panels from leaving errors in subsequent frames.

items.title: Register the independently released Text Animator 0.1.2 and MCP 0.1.21 packages. Text Animator scales its writable character-buffer views in place, including getter-only native views.
items.text: Register the independently released Text Animator 0.1.2 and MCP 0.1.21 packages. Text Animator scales its writable character-buffer views in place, including getter-only native views.

items.title: Rebuild the matching Windows, Linux, Android and Web Player packages for the updated native input interfaces.
items.text: Rebuild the matching Windows, Linux, Android and Web Player packages for the updated native input interfaces.

items.title: Preserve complete editor startup errors and include the process exit code. Wait for the stderr reader to finish without blocking the Hub, so the final exception is not lost.
items.text: Preserve complete editor startup errors and include the process exit code. Wait for the stderr reader to finish without blocking the Hub, so the final exception is not lost.

items.title: Give the Show details button the standard visible button border.
items.text: Give the Show details button the standard visible button border.
